notes.title: Major Update: Missing Pieces Bug Fixed
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry for the delay on this fix. Today's update ensures the pieces load properly and the board is playable again.[/p][p][/p][p]Please update the game and try a new match. If anything still looks off, please let us know so we can follow up quickly.[/p][p][/p][p]Special thanks to ◉_◉ for sharing a community workaround guide that helped us confirm the solution.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support,[/p][p]- Deep Green Games leam[/p]

notes.title: First Major Update is here!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Relax mode added[/b]. Feel like "relaxing" a little? We got you covered with this less challenging new mode. This mode also includes its own leaderboard.
[*] [b]In-game leaderboard[/b]: You don't have to leave the game to check how your score compares to other players.
[*] [b]UI improvements[/b]: You can now select the piece while the opponent is still moving, so you don't lose precious time waiting (thanks Trin, for the feedback). We also added separate visual indicators for when the pill is available and for when the pill can be used. And the animations are now smoother.
[*] [b]Minor bug fixes[/b].
[/list]
